limitations: Pilot population of 1000 MFFI min-test images, 423 real and 577 fake; one seed per frozen candidate.
Degraded target is a deterministic local proxy and is not benchmark Test-D.
Image-only sampling groups do not resolve identity/video/source dependence.
Bootstrap intervals are conditional on these fitted and source-selected checkpoints; they are not across-seed uncertainty.
Generic SBI arms share initialization, backbone, cohort and training budget. HF DINO-SRM is a fixed stronger reference trained under a different regime.
No new training, threshold fitting, severity, polarity, seed or candidate selection follows these target scores.
